race.comment: KICKUP ROCKY (1) has been impressive in Brisbane this prep, winning at both appearances in contrasting styles. Came from near the tail to score running away over 1350m at Doomben last time. Certainly looks ready for another crack at 1600m. PRINCE OF VERONA (2) made it three narrow wins from three career runs when he dug deep to get the cash over 1400m at Warwick Farm last time out. Needs to go to the next level now but that looks well within his capabilities. KATOTO (9) came off a 37-day let-up when easily accounted for in an 1800m Listed race at Flemington on Cup day. Better for that run and coming back to 1600m looks the right move. IMINASTATE (6) stepped out over the mile for the first time last start and collected his maiden win as a $1.60 public elect. Big challenge today but is heading the right way. HOROLOGIST (3) impressed first-up over 1400m at the Farm and looks perfectly placed over this journey second-up.
